copy.heading: The putter situation
body: The Programme acknowledges that a golfer needs a putter. The Programme's research shows that most golfers need one putter. Dave has eleven. Three of them are in the garage, two are in the car, one is behind the sofa, one is in the downstairs loo, one is "at Keith's", and three are unaccounted for. He is still looking for "the right one". Sue suspects the right one is the one he bought for £240 in 2017, used twice, and put in the loft.
The Programme does not ask you to throw any of them away. It asks you to choose two and store the others somewhere that is not the house.
